log.title: Sworn in as President
log.body: Golden Fixture takes the oath of office. Review the budget and your departments: the nation is watching your first decisions.

log.title: Embassy opened in United States
log.body: A permanent mission now works in United States (₹15 crore a month). Relations improve and proposals are likelier to succeed.

log.title: Upgrading Primary care
log.body: ₹4,500 crore goes into the Health department's primary care. It gains a star in about a month.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade
log.body: The service chiefs suggest a large parade to show the forces to the public and raise morale.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions
log.body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Death in police custody
log.body: A man died in a police lock-up. Protests have begun and videos are circulating widely.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo
log.body: The organisers of a major trade expo want India as host. Delegations from dozens of countries would visit, with the contracts and publicity that follow.

log.title: Primary care: 3 stars
log.body: The Health department's primary care is now rated 3 of 5.

log.title: Invitation to host an investor summit
log.body: Industry bodies propose a global investor summit. It would be expensive, but could bring in factories and funds.

log.title: Proposal for a grand military parade: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The parade is shelved and units keep to their training schedule.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Smuggling continues, and so does the bribery that enables it.

log.title: Death in police custody: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You defend the police. Protests grow.

log.title: India is asked to host a world trade expo: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Another country takes the expo.

log.title: Friction with Sweden
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Sweden. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Invitation for a state visit
log.body: A friendly government invites you for a state visit and a round of trade talks.

log.title: Invitation to host an investor summit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline. The idea quietly dies.

log.title: Russia asks India to join sanctions
log.body: Russia is building a coalition to sanction a third state and wants India to join. Doing so would please Russia but cost India trade.

log.title: Fishing boats detained in the south
log.body: Oruvani patrol boats have detained a group of Indian fishing crews in disputed waters. Families are appealing to the government.

log.title: Invitation for a state visit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You decline and stay home.

log.title: France proposes a trade contract
log.body: France offers a 3-year services contract worth ₹1,35,700 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: United Kingdom proposes a trade contract
log.body: United Kingdom offers a 3-year tech contract worth ₹1,35,700 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Export boom
log.body: Overseas demand for manufactured goods and services is surging. Order books are full and customs receipts are up.

log.title: Russia asks India to join sanctions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India says it does not recognise measures outside the UN. Russia is unhappy.

log.title: Global oil price shock
log.body: Supply cuts and a regional crisis have sent crude prices sharply higher. Every importing economy is feeling it, and fuel prices at home are climbing.

log.title: Fishing boats detained in the south: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The case drags on and the families blame the government.

log.title: Gaffe in a live interview
log.body: An off-the-cuff remark in a live interview has gone viral for the wrong reasons.

log.title: Friction with Peru
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Peru. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Friction with Poland
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Poland. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Global oil price shock: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Prices climb and household budgets are squeezed for most of a year.

log.title: Cyclone approaches the South
log.body: A cyclone is bearing down on the South coast with strong winds and a storm surge. Evacuations are under way.

log.title: Cyclone approaches the South: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the South.

log.title: South Africa invites the President to a summit
log.body: South Africa has invited the President to a bilateral summit on trade and security. A visit would be a chance to deepen the relationship.

log.title: Police reform demanded
log.body: After a controversial arrest, civil-rights groups demand sweeping police reform: body cameras, training and oversight.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the South
log.body: Reports say relief grain and blankets meant for the South were sold in the open market. Survivors are furious.

log.title: South Africa invites the President to a summit: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The foreign secretary attends in the President’s place. The host is satisfied.

log.title: Bangladesh agents probe your defences
log.body: Foreign agents mapped sensitive sites before they were noticed. Readiness suffers while the leaks are plugged. Counter-intelligence reduces the risk.

log.title: Germany proposes a trade contract
log.body: Germany offers a 3-year tech contract worth ₹1,39,300 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Relief supplies diverted in the South: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The denials ring hollow and the story grows.

log.title: Water-sharing dispute in the South
log.body: Two neighbouring states in the South are at loggerheads over a river dam. Farmers are blocking highways.

log.title: Hostile hackers probe defence networks
log.body: Cyber teams detect an intrusion into logistics systems. The origin is hidden behind several countries.

log.title: Police reform demanded: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You reject the demand. The criticism gets louder.

log.title: Fighting breaks out near Madagascar
log.body: A dispute between neighbouring states in the region of Madagascar has turned violent. Shipping insurers are raising premiums and capitals are calling for restraint.

log.title: Friction with Afghanistan
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Afghanistan. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Goodwill from Kazakhstan
log.body: Kazakhstan praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Fighting breaks out near Madagascar: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India calls for restraint and keeps its distance.

log.title: Water-sharing dispute in the South: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The dispute festers and violence flares.

log.title: Hostile hackers probe defence networks: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Some data is lost and units spend weeks re-checking their records.

log.title: Maritime incident
log.body: A fishing boat has been seized in disputed waters and the crew are being held. Coastal communities are demanding action.

log.title: Trade dispute with United Kingdom
log.body: United Kingdom has raised duties on Indian goods, saying India’s own tariffs are unfair. Exporters want the government to act.

log.title: Saudi Arabia proposes joint military exercises
log.body: Defence officials in Saudi Arabia have proposed a joint exercise to improve interoperability and signal partnership.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: Japan proposes a trade contract
log.body: Japan offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,41,600 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Goodwill from Norway
log.body: Norway praised India’s role in a regional forum. Relations warm a little.

log.title: Global recession
log.body: Major economies are contracting together. Export orders are drying up and capital is leaving emerging markets.

log.title: Aircraft stray into Indian airspace
log.body: Tirhani aircraft crossed the western frontier for several minutes before turning back. Fighters were scrambled.

log.title: Maritime incident: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The crew stay detained for months. Families protest.

log.title: Trade dispute with United Kingdom: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Exporters absorb the higher duties for months.

log.title: Explosives cache found
log.body: A tip-off led police to a hidden store of explosives and detonators before they could be used.

log.title: Saudi Arabia proposes joint military exercises: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. India declines. The host is mildly disappointed.

log.title: Global recession: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The budget stays disciplined while exports fall. Unemployment drifts up.

log.title: China issues a warning to India
log.body: China’s government has made pointed statements about India’s conduct. A strong, visible military makes such talk less likely.

log.title: Germany proposes a trade contract
log.body: Germany offers a 3-year industry contract worth ₹1,42,800 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Oil price spike
log.body: Crude prices have jumped on supply worries. Petrol, diesel and freight costs are rising across the country.

log.title: Aircraft stray into Indian airspace: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Tirhan calls it a navigation error. The note is filed.

log.title: Friction with Ethiopia
log.body: A dispute over trade and visas has soured the mood in Ethiopia. Relations cool a little.

log.title: Oil price spike: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Prices follow the market. Households feel it at the pump and in the shops.

log.title: Classified files leaked
log.body: A trove of classified files has surfaced online, exposing sources and embarrassing the intelligence services.

log.title: Murmurs in the barracks
log.body: Senior officers are grumbling about pay, promotions and the government's direction. Some talk of "restoring order".

log.title: General strike called
log.body: A coalition of unions and shopkeepers has called a nationwide strike to protest the cost of living and the government's record.

log.title: Press freedom row
log.body: Editors are protesting over a law that would let officials block critical reports. Where do you stand?

log.title: Audit report finds leakage
log.body: The national audit office reports that a sizeable slice of scheme money never reached its targets.

log.title: Murmurs in the barracks: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You ignore the chatter. Resentment hardens.

log.title: Cyclone approaches the South
log.body: A cyclone is bearing down on the South coast with strong winds and a storm surge. Evacuations are under way.

log.title: Cyclone approaches the South: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The central government stays out. Anger builds in the South.

log.title: Land acquisition protests in the Central
log.body: Villagers in the Central are blocking surveyors from a planned industrial corridor, saying compensation is far too low.

log.title: Classified files leaked: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. A review is ordered. Sources go quiet in the meantime.

log.title: South Africa proposes a non-aggression pact
log.body: South Africa proposes that neither country attacks the other for 5 years. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: Annual report 2026
log.body: The government closed 2026 with a deficit of ₹7,66,077 crore. Growth 5.2%, inflation 5.0%, unemployment 8.1%, debt 52.7% of GDP. Approval stands at 33.6%.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions
log.body: Intermediaries suggest that a quiet round of talks with the most hostile neighbour might lower the temperature.

log.title: General strike called: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The strike shuts the cities for days.

log.title: Press freedom row: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You say nothing. The row fades.

log.title: Audit report finds leakage: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. The report is tabled and forgotten.

log.title: Fishing boats detained in the south
log.body: Oruvani patrol boats have detained a group of Indian fishing crews in disputed waters. Families are appealing to the government.

log.title: Land acquisition protests in the Central: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. Work proceeds under heavy police guard. Resentment burns.

log.title: Smuggling network along the border
log.body: Gold, arms and drugs are flowing across a porous stretch of the frontier, with local officials turning a blind eye.

log.title: Intelligence foils a plot by Iron Lotus Cell
log.body: Agents uncovered Iron Lotus Cell preparing an attack in the West. The cell was rolled up before it could act.

log.title: Australia proposes a trade contract
log.body: Australia offers a 3-year agriculture contract worth ₹1,47,300 crore a year. Answer on the Diplomacy screen within 90 days.

log.title: A chance to ease tensions: no decision
log.body: No decision was made in time. You keep your distance. The opposition asks what you are afraid of.

log.title: Tax evasion exposé
log.body: Investigative reporters reveal that large firms and wealthy families have been hiding income abroad. The Finance ministry is under fire.
